exposure: crystalloid preloading (15ml/kg/min ringer lactate for 20 mins prior to induction)
crystalloid co-loading (ringer lactate at 15ml/kg/min in operation theatre)
cohort: The study included 60 adult parturient undergoing elective lower segment caesarean section (LSCS) under spinal anaesthesia.
finding: There was no statistically significant difference in the incidence of hypotension between the preloading and co-loading groups, indicating both methods were equally effective in maintaining hemodynamic stability.
